background: Synthetic existing state; actual state requires host retrieval.
impact: Only the stated tenant scope; no production action in this example.
goals: Make the current required result observable without changing unrelated rights.
flows: Owner inspects scope, reviews change, operator applies once, and verifier reads back success/denial/unknown recovery.

options.description: Reuse the existing capability under its current constraints.
options.tradeoffs: Smallest change; actual compatibility still needs inspection.
options.counterevidence: An absent API or incompatible contract invalidates this option.

options.description: Defer activation until the material gap is resolved.
options.tradeoffs: Delays value but avoids unsupported effects.
options.counterevidence: Unnecessary if current capability and authority can be verified.

requirements.rationale: An enabled member must log in through the chosen IdP and access only its tenant.
Tenant invitations must create only the intended membership and cannot be reused.

criteria.given: An enabled member of tenant A and a real nonproduction IdP.
criteria.when: The member completes code+PKCE login and selects tenant A.
criteria.then: The session endpoint identifies the member and tenant A; the protected API accepts its granted action.
criteria.negative: A cross-tenant request or revoked membership is denied by the server.
criteria.recovery: A lost login reply is reconciled through session readback without duplicate accounts.
criteria.verification: Query each target through the authoritative service.

criteria.given: A tenant-bound invitation and an explicitly approved expiry policy.
criteria.when: Its intended identity accepts it within the approved validity window.
criteria.then: Exactly one intended tenant membership is created and the invitation is consumed.
criteria.negative: Replay, wrong identity and acceptance outside the approved window are denied.
criteria.recovery: A lost acceptance reply reads the existing membership without consuming again.
criteria.verification: Query each target through the authoritative service.

facts: Invitation expiry has no accepted value.
decisions.impact: Only invitation acceptance semantics are undefined.
